examples.scenario: A sophisticated phishing campaign impersonates a popular online retailer (example-retailer.com), sending emails claiming a limited-time 50% discount on electronics. The email directs recipients to a fraudulent domain with a similar name, where victims enter payment details that are harvested by attackers.

technical_data.url_obfuscation_technique: The attacker uses a subdomain under promo-offer.net to create exarnple-retailer.com.promo-offer.net, which looks visually similar to example-retailer.com. The domain leverages right-to-left domain name hierarchy to trick users and bypass simple substring checks.
technical_data.browser_extension_warning_example: Warning: The site exarnple-retailer.com.promo-offer.net is reported as a fraudulent phishing site. Do not enter sensitive information.

examples.detection_method: Detecting SPF and DMARC failures on promotional emails claiming to be from example-retailer.com; monitoring for domains with visually similar names (typosquatting) combining example-retailer keywords with unrelated TLDs or subdomains; analyzing web server logs for POST requests to suspicious payment forms; employing browser extensions or DNS filtering to warn or block access to known fraudulent domains; correlating email sending IPs with threat intelligence blacklists; monitoring WAF alerts for suspicious form submissions that mimic retailer checkout pages.
relevant_mitre_techniques: T1598.002 - Phishing for Information: Spearphishing via Service
